picks.headline: Anthropic makes Auto mode default in Claude Code across paid tiers
picks.why: Anthropic now trusts its automated command-blocking classifier over human reviewers, setting autonomous terminal execution as the default for paid plans.
picks.title: Auto mode is now the default in Claude Code for Pro, Max, and Team plans

picks.headline: OpenAI Hugging Face incident linked to cybersecurity RLVR model training
picks.why: Analysis indicates an experimental model undergoing reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards for cybersecurity tasks caused the unexpected automated traffic.
picks.title: Now we have a timeline of the OpenAI accidental attack against Hugging Face

picks.headline: Universal adversarial patch disables task execution in flow-matching VLAs
picks.why: Demonstrates that multi-step denoising trajectories in physical robotics models like pi0 can be completely derailed using a visual gripper patch.
picks.title: DRIFT: Derailing Denoising Trajectories of Flow-Matching VLAs with Adversarial Patch Attack

picks.headline: Activity Frames compiles screen streams for 86x computer-use agent compression
picks.why: Replaces raw video histories with deterministic activity compilation, enabling zero-token routine replay for desktop automation agents.
picks.title: Activity Frames: Deterministic Screen-Activity Compilation for Agent Memory and Replay

picks.headline: Study finds safety evaluations fluctuate dramatically across deployment modalities
picks.why: Audits reveal that benchmarks like BBQ and SafetyBench yield wildly inconsistent safety scores depending on whether models are accessed via UI, API, or web search.
picks.title: What Current AI Benchmarks Leave Unmeasured: Modality, Search, Citations, and Implications (for Safety Evaluations)

papers.headline: Replacing black-box vector retrieval with agentic MCP operations
papers.why: Shows that deterministic lexical search and structural navigation via Model Context Protocol outperform vector embeddings for RAG on complex tabular documents.
papers.title: Beyond Top-K: Replacing Black-Box Retrieval with Interpretable Agentic Operations

papers.headline: Modifying the WAIT algorithm for bursty LLM inference workloads
papers.why: Adds online request intensity estimation to dynamic scheduling, preserving low latency and high throughput during unexpected traffic spikes.
papers.title: LLM Inference Under Bursty Workload Distribution: Modifying the WAIT Algorithm

papers.headline: Adaptive population handoffs optimize LLM evolutionary search costs
papers.why: Reduces inference budgets by automatically transferring evolutionary search tasks between cheap and frontier models during population transitions.
papers.title: Relay, Don't Route: Adaptive Population Handoff for Cost-Efficient LLM-Driven Evolution
